title: How to job search prep for 2025
description:
Who else is prepping for their new year job search rn??

I'm using Teal to help me find high paying roles and steal the skills they list.

So when I'm ready to start applying, I'll have a resume full of highly desired skills in my industry.

I'm working smarter, definitely not harder in 2025

#jobsearchtips #jobsearchadvice #jobsearching
transcript: guess I'm like everybody else and I'm looking for a new job in the new year I don't really want to start applying to jobs yet but this is what I'm doing to prepare for when I am ready I'm using LinkedIn to actually find jobs and then I'm using this teal Chrome extension to see when they actually pay well and when they do then I'm adding them to my job tracker now we're in my job tracker I can see the job description broken out and the different skills that are involved in it so now I'm going to take this information and add it into my resume which is super easy I just go here to this button resume and then I go over here and I go to my resume here it tells me what my resume's match score is to the actual job description and it lists out all those skills that we were looking at I can literally add them to my resume with a click of a button watch this I'm going to add content calendars so it pulls it up over here it found a place where it could go into my resume I'm going to click that and it helps my score I'm going to be ready to go in the new year
